author: Lauren Degraaff
body: I was hesitant to buy a sleep program from Andrea because I felt I had done a lot of research and wasn’t sure if her program would give me new insights. I definitely made the right choice to get the program! My daughter had split nights, my husband and I weren’t getting any sleep and I didn’t know how to be flexible with her schedule since I have a toddler as well. Within a week she was completely sleeping though the night. Best investment I’ve made in a long time.
